topography.project_purpose: Velvet.Capital is a DeFi protocol that enables users to create and manage tokenized portfolios (indexes) and yield-generating vaults. It provides infrastructure for automated portfolio rebalancing and yield optimization across multiple chains.
topography.relationship_narrative: Both families share infrastructure such as ProtocolConfig and TokenRegistry contracts, and use ERC1967Proxy for upgradeability. VelvetToken from V2 may be used within V3 portfolios, linking the two versions.
